name: Typed Confirm Dialog
description: A destructive confirm that grows out of its trigger, traps focus and enables Delete only once the exact name is typed. It lists what is lost and offers Archive instead.

props.name: triggerLabel
props.description: The button in the card that opens the dialog.

props.name: resourceName
props.description: The exact name the visitor must type before Delete enables.

props.name: environments
props.description: Environments that go with the project, counted up in the ledger.

props.name: lastDeployHours
props.description: Hours since the last deploy, shown as “3 h ago”.

props.name: secrets
props.description: Environment variables that go with the project.

props.name: requireTyping
props.description: Ask for the exact name first. Off, Delete is a single plain confirm.

props.name: alternative
props.description: Offer “Archive instead”, which keeps environments and history.

props.name: tone
props.description: Red for removal; the theme’s ink for anything milder.

props.name: theme
props.description: The surface the dialog sits on, so its scrim, field and text keep their contrast.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Leave it out and the trigger owns it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires on every open and close: the trigger, Cancel, Esc, the scrim, or a finished delete.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Runs with the typed name. Return a promise for the pending state; reject it for the error state.

props.name: onArchive
props.description: Runs when the visitor picks Archive instead. A promise holds the dialog open until it settles.
